evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp error handling for getrawtransaction and ProcessPSBT.
rationale: RPC methods currently return misleading 'No such transaction found' errors during I/O errors or when blocks are pruned or un-downloaded. The PR description notes that 'Reporting a confirmed transaction as missing is wrong, so properly return an error instead', fixing returned error correctness for RPC consumers.
